DashboardLoadTest.title: Load Test
DashboardLoadTest.description: Fires read-only requests at the live edge functions and reports latency percentiles. Runs from the admin server (service key never leaves it). Concurrency is hard-capped at 20 virtual users × 20 iterations per scenario — this is a smoke-level check against production, not a stress rig.

DashboardLoadTestComponentsLoadTestRunne.totalRequestsSummary: {total} total requests ({scenarios, plural, one {# scenario} other {# scenarios}} × {vus} × {iterations}), run sequentially per scenario
DashboardLoadTestComponentsLoadTestRunne.baselineNote: Green dot: zero errors and p95 under 2s. Baseline (2026-07): p50 ≈ 450ms, p95 < 1s at 10 VUs.
